contributions.claim: Province South Holland wrongly announced its first wolf sighting; reporter supplied wrong location and actually saw the animal in Limburg.
contributions.uncertainty: Source explicitly describes corrected earlier report; original announcement not independently visible in prefix.

contributions.claim: BIJ12 says the reported April 17 Barendrecht sighting was wrong: reporter saw wolf in Limburg and home address was accidentally selected on map; attempted correction did not reach wildlife association.
contributions.uncertainty: Explains reported correction; no claim wolves cannot ever occur in South Holland.

contributions.claim: NU.nl says first South Holland wolf sighting occurred in Barendrecht three weeks earlier, conflicting with already visible source correction locating reported animal in Limburg.
contributions.attribution: NU.nl report versus Telegraaf provincial-error account
contributions.uncertainty: Later O041 explicitly explains this first Barendrecht report as mislocated Limburg sighting; retain NU attribution as history, not current South Holland sighting.

contributions.claim: NU.nl now explicitly says its earlier all-provinces wolf news was incorrect and attributes location-error correction to BIJ12.
contributions.uncertainty: Corroborates already captured correction; no further physical occurrence.

relations.reason: Same first South Holland claim and Barendrecht reporter context strongly suggest same sighting report.
NU asserts first South Holland/Barendrecht sighting that visible correction rejects; nominal later timestamp does not establish reversal.
Explicit earlier-in-day first Barendrecht report is identified as erroneous.
Limburg/home address/Barendrecht mechanism identifies same reporting error.
Same publisher explicitly retracts earlier-day all-provinces report.

delta_expectations.reason: Original publisher explicitly reverses earlier claim; meaningful attribution/correction state changes although animal location was already corrected.

ambiguity_notes: Do not reopen a new South Holland wolf event. Publication-order simulation means no authentic availability claim.
current_view_policy: Prior contributions and unresolved questions retained as attributed evidence; current delta expectations apply only at this prefix, not to repeated context.

decisions.decision: Require publisher acknowledgment as correction/provenance update, not new animal event.
decisions.reason: O040 explicitly withdraws earlier-day all-provinces claim. A requires update, B allows; original claimant acknowledgment meaningfully changes status of disputed source.

decisions.decision: Require corrected-by link to earlier NU claim; prior source-described correction remains history.
decisions.reason: Same publisher and explicit earlier-Friday reference support linkage.
